sn17.11:1.1: Sāvatthi || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || adhigamāya || || Idhāham bhikkhave ekaccam puggalam evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi || na cāyam āyasmā suvaṇṇapatiyā pi rūpiyacuṇṇa-paripuṇṇāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā ti || || Tam enam passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtam pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ || || Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Pathamam || ||
